column27: Ameriabank (French capital), EvocaBank (ex-Converse Bank), ACBA Bank (French Credit Agricole shareholder), Ardshinbank — all have small but growing analytics/risk teams. Credit risk modelling, Basel-adjacent analytics, portfolio monitoring. Small teams by any measure; quant finance as a distinct function is rare. Anchored on Armenian banking sector salary data. Very limited direct data

EPAM Armenia (significant office post-Russia sanctions), Andersen Armenia, Synopsys Yerevan (engineering analytics adjacent) — employ data scientists and analysts. Some quant analytics work for international clients. International employers pay significantly above local banking rates; closest to quant finance compensation in Armenia. Very limited quant-specific data

notes: Small Armenian FinTech: IDBank digital, Unibank digital, Ameriabank fintech subsidiary. Mostly data analyst profiles rather than quant finance. Base tier reflecting below-average regional compensation. Included for completeness

column27: Armenia has attracted some crypto companies since 2022 (post-Russia relocation wave). Some algorithmic trading and crypto pricing analytics roles emerging in Yerevan. Very thin market; compensation above local banking. Directional estimate based on regional crypto analytics benchmarks
